selection: Only the 33 conservative physical-network representative STUDY_IDs; no alternate biology-selected cohorts

notes: Shapefile L1 land polygon, not proof of oceanic geological origin
Polygon area attributes are in km^2 and must be validated
Only official GitHub release asset, no alternate geometry substitution after inspection

frame.site: latitude and longitude rounded to 5 decimals
frame.eligible_site: same study, same site, same calendar month, consecutive years with >=2 distinct SAMPLE_DESC sampling events in each month-year

polygon_rules.outside_land_polygons: water or unclassified; do not infer absence or continental site
polygon_rules.small_landmass: polygon under 5 km2, outside primary island analytical universe; report separately
polygon_rules.island: L1 polygon 5 to <7 million km2, not independently classed as oceanic vs continental island
polygon_rules.overlapping_polygon_membership: STOP, do not choose polygon after looking at the site outcome

study_island_network_requirement.marine_realm: analyzed only as nearshore/marine, NEVER called island land observations

artifacts.permit: per STUDY_ID counts by land/island/mainland/water categories and number of island polygon groups; global source checksum; source-safe categorical quality summary
artifacts.forbid: BioTIME site coordinates, taxa, individual sample, abundance/biomass, species future responses

scientific_gate: If fewer than two independent archipelago/geography blocks remain, STOP a universal literal-island occupancy-network claim. The existing 33 remain a general global repeated-community research line only.
